scored_by: Claude, by hand, 2026-10-30, from the 251-claim live library
rule: same = the earlier verdict would be right for the other wording; any added, dropped or changed detail other than a source = different

pairs.a: Ken Paxton has repeatedly ignored invitations to debate James Talarico ahead of the election.
pairs.b: Ken Paxton has repeatedly ignored invitations to debate.
pairs.label: same
pairs.why: B only drops the opponent's name; the debate invitations are the same ones

pairs.a: Donald Trump and JD Vance defended Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign ad.
pairs.b: Dana Bash stated that President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance defended Vivek Ramaswamy's advertisement.
pairs.label: same
pairs.why: B adds a source (Dana Bash stated that ...)

pairs.a: Federal authorities are investigating allegations of immigration fraud regarding Rep. Ilhan Omar's citizenship.
pairs.b: Federal authorities are investigating potential fraud in Omar's family's immigration paperwork.
pairs.label: different
pairs.why: A: fraud about Omar's own citizenship; B: her family's immigration paperwork. Close, but a different subject, so not the same claim

pairs.a: Trump's lawyers cited matters of national importance, including the war in Iran and the war between Russia and Ukraine, for canceling the October 16 deposition.
pairs.b: Trump's attorneys cited the war in Iran and the war between Russia and Ukraine as matters of national importance to postpone his deposition.
pairs.label: different
pairs.why: canceling vs postponing, and A names the October 16 date

pairs.a: Donald Trump and JD Vance defended Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign ad.
pairs.b: Vice President Vance and Vivek Ramaswamy defended the campaign ad.
pairs.label: different
pairs.why: Trump and Vance vs Vance and Ramaswamy

pairs.a: Police reported Oliver was arrested and charged with operating under the influence of alcohol.

pairs.label: same
pairs.why: B adds the first name and drops 'Police reported'; same arrest and charge

pairs.a: President Trump was making his third trip to Texas this month.

pairs.b: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa alleged in her lawsuit that Gov. Greg Abbott is unlawfully withholding communications between his office and Elon Musk.
